# What Strategic Banking Partnerships Mean for Business Growth in 2026


April 30, 2026


- [Home](https://www.coastalstatesbank.com/)

**Why Planning Ahead Matters for Growth**


As businesses look toward expansion in 2026, having a clear plan can make a meaningful difference. Growth brings opportunity, but it also requires thoughtful decisions around cash flow, financing, and long-term strategy.


In this recent Georgia CEO feature, Coastal States Bank Commercial Banking Team Leader Harold Liles shares insights on the key areas businesses should prioritize when preparing to expand. From aligning financial resources with business goals to navigating changing market conditions, his perspective highlights the importance of working with a bank that understands both your business and your community.


**Watch Harold Liles[Georgia CEO feature](https://youtu.be/YuV3ofDWwGY) , to learn more about how the right banking partner can support your business as you plan for growth.**
